zh: 美股週四全面重挫：標普 500 收 7,175.83 點、跌 2.02%，連續第六個交易日下跌，路透預估本週將是 2025 年 4 月以來最大單週跌幅；道瓊收 49,097.06 點、跌 2.19%；那斯達克收 23,879.20 點、跌 2.25%。紐約交易所下跌家數是上漲家數的 4.37 倍，新低 796 檔對新高 21 檔，成交量 208.3 億股、高於 20 日均量 190 億股。恐慌指數 VIX 約 28.5，單日升約 16%（盤面快照，非正式收盤）。
en: US stocks fell broadly on Thursday: the S&P 500 closed at 7,175.83, down 2.02% for a sixth straight loss and on course for its steepest weekly drop since April 2025; the Dow closed at 49,097.06, down 2.19%; the Nasdaq Composite closed at 23,879.20, down 2.25%. On the NYSE decliners outnumbered advancers 4.37 to 1, with 796 new lows against 21 new highs, and volume of 20.83 billion shares topped the 19.0 billion 20-day average. The VIX was near 28.5, up about 16% in a market snapshot rather than an official close.

道瓊 ETF，指數跌 2.19%

zh: 週四的跌勢集中在 AI 鏈：AMD 大跌 7.7%，起因是調查媒體 Hunterbrook 表示旗下基金已對 AMD 建立空頭部位；CoreWeave 跌 6.1%、Nebius 跌 9.4%、美光與博通各跌 2.1%，費城半導體指數跌 2.4%，整體科技類股跌 1.9%。路透引述 Argent Capital 的分析師說，他對資料中心資本支出成長的看法「過去一兩個月降了一些」。需要留意的是，空頭報告只是一方的論點，不等於公司基本面已經改變。
en: The selloff centred on the AI chain: AMD dropped 7.7% after investigative outlet Hunterbrook said its affiliated fund had taken a short position; CoreWeave fell 6.1%, Nebius 9.4%, Micron and Broadcom 2.1% each, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index 2.4% and the broader tech sector 1.9%. An Argent Capital analyst told Reuters his view on data-center capex growth had come down a little over the last month or two. A short report is one side's thesis and does not by itself mean fundamentals have changed.

stocks.n: 週四 -7.7%，Hunterbrook 披露空頭部位
AI 雲端算力，-6.1%
AI 雲端基礎設施，-9.4%
網通與客製晶片，-2.1%

zh: Anthropic 週四在那斯達克掛牌（代號 ANT），週三深夜以每股 83 美元定價，被路透稱為史上最大 IPO。開盤價 111.50 美元，盤中高點 115 美元（比發行價高 38.6%），市值一度超過 2 兆美元，但漲幅逐步縮小，收盤約 97.17 美元、漲 17.1%。Argent 的分析師提醒，不宜從當天交易過度推論 AI 的整體前景。這則新聞同時說明：這麼大的新股也沒能把當天的 AI 賣壓擋下來。
en: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT after pricing late Wednesday at $83 per share, which Reuters called the largest IPO on record. It opened at $111.50, touched $115 (38.6% above the offer price) and briefly valued the company above $2 trillion, but gains faded and it closed around $97.17, up 17.1%. An Argent analyst cautioned against extrapolating much from one day of trading. Even an IPO this large could not offset the AI selling that day.

stocks.n: Anthropic，發行價 83、收約 97.17、首日 +17.1%
AI 與大型科技權重高的指數 ETF

zh: 利率與商品面：10 年期美債殖利率約 5.05%、5 年期約 4.86%、30 年期約 5.41%，美元指數約 103.9。黃金期貨跌 3.05% 到每盎司約 3,628 美元，白銀跌 4.92% 到約 42.8 美元。這些數字來自盤面快照（非官方收盤），僅供方向參考。升息預期上升通常讓不生息的貴金屬吸引力下降，但這天的跌幅同時發生在股市重挫日，可能還有部位調整的因素。
en: On rates and commodities, the 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.05%, the 5-year about 4.86%, the 30-year about 5.41% and the dollar index about 103.9. Gold futures fell 3.05% to roughly $3,628 an ounce and silver fell 4.92% to about $42.8. These figures come from a market snapshot, not official closes, so treat them as directional. Rising rate-hike odds usually reduce the appeal of non-yielding metals, but the drop came on a heavy equity selloff day, so position unwinding may also have played a part.

白銀 ETF，銀價單日約 -4.9%

zh: 資安公司 Palo Alto Networks 週四上漲 6.4%，原因是上調 2027 會計年度的營收預期（路透）。在整體科技類股下跌 1.9%、半導體下跌 2.4% 的一天，這是少數逆勢走強的科技股；同屬資安的 CrowdStrike 也漲約 2.7%。這個反應顯示市場並非一概賣科技，而是在區分「資本支出受惠鏈」與「軟體與訂閱營收」。細節數字路透原文未列，本卡不補推測。
en: Cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks rose 6.4% on Thursday after raising its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook, Reuters reported. On a day when tech fell 1.9% and semiconductors 2.4%, it was one of the few tech names to rise; peer CrowdStrike gained about 2.7%. The reaction suggests the market is not selling all tech indiscriminately but separating the capex-driven chain from software and subscription revenue. Reuters did not list the detailed figures, so none are guessed here.

stocks.n: 週四 +6.4%，上調 2027 年度營收預期
同為資安，約 +2.7%（盤面快照）

zh: Walmart 公布第三季：營收年增 5.2% 到 1,888 億美元，高於預期的約 1,874 億；不含燃料的同店銷售成長 2.9%，與預期相符，高於上一季的 2.6%，但低於去年同期的 4.5%。全球電商成長 17%、美國電商成長 23%，美國實體店同店則下滑（財務長說法）。公司第三度上調全年展望，但幅度比分析師預期保守，路透稱年度銷售預測令投資人失望，股價週四跌 1.0%。
en: Walmart reported third-quarter revenue up 5.2% to $188.8 billion, above the roughly $187.4 billion expected; comparable sales excluding fuel rose 2.9%, in line with forecasts and above last quarter's 2.6% but below 4.5% a year earlier. Global e-commerce grew 17% and US e-commerce 23%, while US store comparable sales declined according to the CFO. It raised its full-year outlook for a third time, but by less than analysts hoped; Reuters said the annual sales forecast disappointed and the shares fell 1.0% on Thursday.

stocks.n: 第三季營收 1,888 億美元，股價 -1.0%
民生消費 ETF，觀察防禦族群是否承接

zh: Nvidia 在 11 月 17 日公布的財報超預期：營收 1,158 億美元、年增 103%，調整後每股盈餘 2.68 美元（預期約 2.48），第四季營收預測 1,300 億美元上下 3%，且不含中國資料中心運算營收；毛利率預計由 74.8% 降到 71% 至 72%。路透說上調的預測「沒能提振情緒」，股價週四再跌 3.3%、已連六個交易日下跌。創辦人黃仁勳在 11 月 12 日辭任，財務長 Kress 暫代執行長。
en: Nvidia's results reported on November 17 beat expectations: revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103%, adjusted EPS of $2.68 against about $2.48 expected, and a fourth-quarter revenue forecast of $130 billion plus or minus 3% with no China data-center compute assumed; gross margin is guided to fall from 74.8% to 71%-72%. Reuters said the upbeat forecast did little to lift sentiment, and the stock fell another 3.3% on Thursday for a sixth straight decline. Jensen Huang resigned on November 12, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO.

stocks.n: 財報超預期但週四 -3.3%、連六跌
半導體 ETF，觀察龍頭疲弱是否外溢

zh: 聯準會 10 月會議紀要在週三公布，顯示官員想壓抑通膨，而這份紀要是在最近 CPI 與 PPI 偏熱之前的討論。芝商所 FedWatch 顯示 12 月 9 日會議升息 1 碼（25 個基點）的機率約 96.4%，另有小幅但增加的升 2 碼機率。聯準會已在 9 月升息 1 碼（2023 年以來首次），10 月以 10 比 2 的票數維持不動（Motley Fool 的整理）。市場目前的問題已不是會不會升，而是升多少、之後還升不升。
en: The Fed's October minutes, released Wednesday, showed officials wanted to rein in inflation, a discussion that predates the recent hot CPI and PPI prints. CME FedWatch put the odds of a 25 basis point hike at the December 9 meeting at about 96.4%, with a small but growing chance of 50 basis points. The Fed raised rates a quarter point in September, its first hike since 2023, and held in October on a 10-2 vote, per a Motley Fool summary. The question is no longer whether but how much, and how many more.

stocks.n: 短天期美債 ETF，最直接反映政策利率預期
中天期美債 ETF，升息路徑的中段

tag: CPI 偏熱 PPI 持平
zh: 10 月 CPI 月增 0.4%，高於預期的 0.3%，核心 CPI 月增 0.3%；10 月 PPI 月增 0.3%，低於預期的 0.4%，核心 PPI 月增 0.3%、與預期一致（Motley Fool 11 月 14 日整理）。消費端物價比生產端更熱，意味著成本壓力已經在往終端價格傳。路透指出，這些數字讓市場對升息幅度的押注上移；下週三的 PCE 是 12 月會議前的最後一份通膨數據。
en: October CPI rose 0.4% month on month against 0.3% expected, with core CPI up 0.3%; October PPI rose 0.3% against 0.4% expected, with core PPI up 0.3% as forecast, per a November 14 Motley Fool summary. Consumer prices running hotter than producer prices suggests cost pressure is passing through to final prices. Reuters noted the data pushed up bets on the size of hikes, and next Wednesday's PCE is the last inflation read before the December meeting.

stocks.n: 抗通膨債券 ETF，通膨數據的直接受惠者
能源 ETF，油價與通膨預期連動

zh: 盤面快照顯示殖利率曲線：3 個月期約 4.26%、5 年期約 4.86%、10 年期約 5.05%、30 年期約 5.41%，10 年減 2 年利差約 31 個基點。10 年期殖利率在 9 月中旬首度站上 5%，9 月底創多年新高（Kitco 引述路透），現在仍在 5% 上方。長天期殖利率高於政策利率，對房貸、公司債與小型股的融資成本都是持續的壓力，這是這輪股市估值壓縮的背景。
en: A market snapshot shows the yield curve: 3-month about 4.26%, 5-year about 4.86%, 10-year about 5.05% and 30-year about 5.41%, with the 10-year minus 2-year spread near 31 basis points. The 10-year yield first crossed 5% in mid-September and set multi-decade highs in late September (Kitco, citing Reuters), and it remains above 5%. Long yields well above the policy rate keep pressure on mortgages, corporate bonds and small-cap financing costs, which is the backdrop to this equity valuation squeeze.

stocks.n: 20 年期以上美債 ETF，長天期殖利率代理
投資級公司債 ETF，信用利差觀察
房貸抵押債 ETF，房貸利率的傳導

zh: 科技類股整體下跌 1.9%，大型權值股無一倖免：Amazon 約跌 3.9%、Google 母公司 Alphabet 約跌 3.5%、Meta 約跌 3.3%、Tesla 約跌 2.4%、微軟約跌 1.8%、蘋果約跌 0.9%（盤面快照，非官方收盤）。蘋果跌幅最小、AI 資本支出敏感的雲端與社群巨頭跌幅較大，顯示賣壓的差別來自對 AI 投資報酬的疑慮，而非單純的指數連動。
en: The tech sector fell 1.9% overall and none of the mega-caps escaped: Amazon was down about 3.9%, Alphabet about 3.5%, Meta about 3.3%, Tesla about 2.4%, Microsoft about 1.8% and Apple about 0.9%, per a market snapshot rather than official closes. Apple fell least while cloud and social giants with heavy AI capex fell more, suggesting the selling reflects doubts about AI investment returns rather than simple index correlation.

zh: 跌的不只是科技。醫療照護的 Universal Health Services 約跌 6.0%（10 月底曾因同業 HCA 說明 2027 年醫療補助補充付款將減少 5.5 億到 6.5 億美元而下跌 6%）；支付科技 Fiserv 約跌 6.4%、收約 56.6 美元（11 月 3 日財報後曾大漲 12.5%，11 月 9 日收 63.52 美元）；外送平台 DoorDash 約跌 5.8%。這三檔週四的具體原因我沒有查到可靠說明，只能說：升息預期與大盤重挫之下，非科技股也沒有避風港。
en: The selling was not limited to tech. Hospital operator Universal Health Services fell about 6.0% (it also fell 6% in late October when peer HCA flagged $550 million to $650 million less Medicaid supplemental payment benefit in 2027); payments company Fiserv fell about 6.4% to around $56.6 (it jumped 12.5% after earnings on November 3 and closed at $63.52 on November 9); and DoorDash fell about 5.8%. I could not find reliable explanations for Thursday's moves in these three; all one can say is that amid hike expectations and a heavy market selloff, non-tech names offered no shelter.

stocks.n: 約 -6.0%，醫療補助政策敏感的醫院股
約 -5.8%，外送平台

zh: 商品價格的分化：WTI 原油約 83.1 美元、上漲 1.0%，布蘭特約 92.7 美元持平；天然氣跌 3.8%、銅跌 1.4%（盤面快照）。油價比 9 月中旬曾站上的每桶 100 美元已回落不少，但仍在高位，是通膨壓力的來源之一。銅與天然氣下跌則反映市場對景氣放緩的定價，這和油價的走勢方向不同，值得分開看。
en: Commodities diverged: WTI crude was about $83.1, up 1.0%, and Brent about $92.7, flat; natural gas fell 3.8% and copper 1.4%, per a market snapshot. Oil is well below the $100 a barrel touched in mid-September but remains elevated and is one source of inflation pressure. Falling copper and natural gas price in slower growth, which points the opposite way from crude and is worth reading separately.

天然氣 ETF，單日約 -3.8%

zh: 高盛的統計是：羅素 2000 成分公司約 32% 持有浮動利率債務，標普 500 只有約 6%。這代表升息對小型股的融資成本影響來得又快又直接，而且高盛仍預期 2027 上半年還有兩次升息。這是小型股在這一輪利率環境下和大型股最大的結構差異之一，也解釋了為什麼利率消息出來時，小型股的反應常比指數更劇烈。
en: Goldman Sachs estimates that about 32% of Russell 2000 companies carry floating-rate debt against about 6% in the S&P 500. A hike therefore feeds into small-cap financing costs quickly and directly, and Goldman still expects two more hikes by the first half of 2027. This is one of the main structural differences between small and large caps in the current rate regime, and it helps explain why small caps often react more sharply to rate news than the broad index.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，利率敏感度最高的代表
標普小型股 600 ETF，獲利門檻較高的對照

zh: 羅素 2000 在 11 月 6 日收約 2,756 點，前一天曾單日重挫 4.45%，當天反彈 0.97%；IWM 收約 272.5 美元。8 月中旬的紀錄高點在 3,045 到 3,053 點之間（兩個來源數字略有差異），所以 11 月初已比高點低約一成。我沒有查到 11 月 19 日羅素 2000 的收盤數字，大盤當天重挫、小型股很可能也承壓，但不能當成事實寫進來。
en: The Russell 2000 closed near 2,756 on November 6 after a 4.45% one-day plunge the day before, bouncing 0.97% that day; IWM closed near $272.5. The August record high was between 3,045 and 3,053 depending on the source, so the index was already roughly 10% below its peak in early November. I could not find the Russell 2000 close for November 19; with the market falling sharply small caps were likely under pressure too, but that cannot be stated as fact here.

stocks.n: 11 月 6 日收約 272.5 美元
羅素 2000 的另一檔 ETF，費用率較低

zh: 小型股判讀知識：同樣叫「小型股」，不同指數的池子差很多。羅素 2000 涵蓋範圍大、包含不少尚未獲利的公司，標普小型股 600 要求過去四季合計獲利為正，所以後者通常品質較高、波動較小。看到「小型股大漲或大跌」時，先確認講的是哪個指數，再看它是由利率、獲利還是少數權值股帶動，否則容易把不同池子的數字混著比。
en: A small-cap reading tip: not all small-cap indexes are the same pool. The Russell 2000 is broad and includes many companies that are not yet profitable, while the S&P SmallCap 600 requires positive trailing earnings, so the latter tends to be higher quality and less volatile. When you see small caps surge or sink, first check which index is meant, then whether rates, earnings or a handful of heavyweights drove it; otherwise numbers from different pools get compared by mistake.

stocks.n: CRSP 小型股 ETF，另一種小型股池子
標普小型股 600，要求獲利為正
標普小型成長股，風格細分的對照

zh: 農化公司 FMC 週四約跌 8.3%、收約 4.29 美元（盤面快照）。這家公司 10 月 15 日因大幅下調展望盤中暴跌約 32%；較早的資料也顯示其現金約 5 億美元、負債約 45 億美元（2025 年底前後的整理，數字可能已變動）。股價落到個位數後，小型股的流動性與融資壓力問題會被放大。我沒有查到 11 月 19 日這一天的個別消息，請把它當作波動案例，不是研究結論。
en: Agricultural chemicals company FMC fell about 8.3% on Thursday to roughly $4.29, per a market snapshot. It plunged about 32% intraday on October 15 after sharply cutting its outlook, and earlier data showed about $500 million of cash against roughly $4.5 billion of debt (a figure from around late 2025 that may have changed). With the price in single digits, small-cap liquidity and financing pressure are magnified. I found no company-specific news for November 19, so treat this as a volatility example, not a research conclusion.

stocks.n: 農化同業，供對照

zh: EquipmentShare（EQPT）是租賃建設設備並提供科技平台的公司，2026 年掛牌。InsiderPrint 11 月 19 日列出三位內部人在 11 月 11 日到 17 日買進合計約 130 萬美元、均價 14.46 美元，包括執行長 Schlacks 約 56.3 萬、董事 Hill 約 55.4 萬、總裁約 14.5 萬。這個均價低於它 9 月初資料中的 52 週低點 15.71 美元；執行長自 8 月底起也多次買進。反方：主要股東 Chheda 8 月賣出約 220 萬股、約 4,540 萬美元，分析師共識僅「持有」。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: EquipmentShare (EQPT) rents construction equipment alongside a technology platform and listed in 2026. InsiderPrint on November 19 listed three insiders buying about $1.3 million between November 11 and 17 at an average $14.46, including CEO Schlacks (about $563K), director Hill (about $554K) and the president (about $145K). That average is below the 52-week low of $15.71 shown in early-September data, and the CEO had also bought repeatedly since late August. Counterpoint: major holder Chheda sold about 2.2 million shares, roughly $45.4 million, in August, and the analyst consensus is only Hold. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Suncrete（RMIX）自稱是預拌混凝土的物流與配送平台，據點在奧克拉荷馬、阿肯色、路易斯安那與德州。InsiderPrint 列出五位內部人在 11 月 17 到 18 日買進合計約 110 萬美元、均價 6.14 美元，董事 Rees-Jones 就佔約 73.1 萬美元，營運長也買。我查到的報價快照互相不一致（8.93 到 18.25 美元不等），無法確認買價相對現價的位置，需要用即時報價核對。另外，部分 Form 4 是限制型股票的授予，不是公開市場買進。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Suncrete (RMIX) describes itself as a ready-mix concrete logistics and distribution platform in Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana and Texas. InsiderPrint lists five insiders buying about $1.1 million on November 17-18 at an average $6.14, with director Rees-Jones alone accounting for about $731K and the COO also buying. The price snapshots I found conflict (from $8.93 to $18.25), so I cannot confirm where the buy price sits relative to the current quote; check a live quote. zh: 判讀提醒：內部人買進的理由通常只有一個（認為股價低估），賣出的理由卻有很多（稅務、分散、買房）。所以一個叢集買進的資訊量，大於同樣金額的賣出。但要小心兩件事：一是定義不統一（有的要求兩人以上、有的要求三人在兩週內）；二是同一檔股票可能同時有內部人買、大股東賣，例如 EQPT 的高階主管買進與主要股東 Chheda 的 4,540 萬美元賣出並存。看清楚「誰」買、「誰」賣，比看總額更重要。
en: A reading tip: insiders usually buy for one reason (they think the stock is undervalued) but sell for many (taxes, diversification, a house), so a cluster buy carries more information than a sale of the same size. Two cautions: definitions vary (some require two insiders, others three within two weeks), and one stock can have insiders buying while a major holder sells, as with EQPT, where executive purchases coexist with a $45.4 million sale by major holder Chheda. Who buys and who sells matters more than the total.

en: Congress Stock tallied 88 trades filed for November 7-14, of which Cisneros alone accounted for 58; the largest listed trades all dated from October, and one STRC trade made on June 5 was only filed on November 10, 158 days later. Read it as who filed what, not as a signal to buy or sell.
